description: Take a task from list_tasks: it moves to claimed on your desk and no other bot can take it (409 when another bot already holds it; 403 with the assignee's name when it is not yours to take). Calling it again for a task you hold is harmless. Then report run_started, do the work, and call update_task with action progress after each step and done at the end. Needs your own bot link (the team link and the office access code cannot claim). Same as POST /v1/in/tasks/:task_id/claim.

agent_id.description: Only on a link that is not bound to one bot: which bot is claiming.

task_id.description: The task id from list_tasks (tsk_ + 12 characters).

name: claim_task
title: Claim a task
